name: tracer
description: Merged is not deployed: follow a merged PR or commit through its workflow runs, deployments and an optional live URL with gh, on a pixel-art level map, and wake the session once when it is live or a stage fails.

intervalSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
intervalSeconds.description: How often tracer polls workflow runs, deployments and the live URL.

timeoutMinutes.title: Give up after (minutes)
timeoutMinutes.description: Stop following a commit this long after /trace, with a TIME UP toast.

environments.title: Deploy environments
environments.description: Comma-separated GitHub deployment environments to wait for, in order (e.g. staging, production). Empty: follow whatever deployments appear, and if none do, BUILD is the final stage.

liveUrl.title: Live URL
liveUrl.description: Optional URL to fetch once the deploys are done; {sha} and {short} are filled in. The chain is LIVE when the body contains the SHA (full or 7-character).

liveMatch.title: Live match
liveMatch.description: Optional text the live body must contain instead of the SHA; {sha} and {short} are filled in.

wake.title: Wake the session
wake.description: final: submit one line when the chain reaches its last stage or a stage fails. never: only toast and redraw.
